name: project-wizard help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:project-wizard. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Start over
entries.text: Starts over. Part of Project wizard.

entries.title: Project wizard settings
entries.text: Opens the project wizard settings. Part of Project wizard.

entries.title: Open claude.ai
entries.text: Opens Open claude.ai.

entries.title: Copy instructions
entries.text: Copies instructions. Paste it wherever you need it. Part of Project wizard.

entries.title: Download context files
entries.text: Downloads context files. Part of Project wizard.

entries.title: Save link
entries.text: Saves link. Nothing is kept until you tap it. Part of Project wizard.

entries.title: Remove from list
entries.text: Removes from list. Depending on your behaviour theme it asks first. Part of Project wizard.

entries.title: Check again
entries.text: Checks again. Part of Project wizard.

entries.title: Project wizard
entries.text: Shows the “Project wizard” part of this screen. Part of Project wizard.

entries.title: Project name
entries.text: The name people see: the console workspace, the repo description and the Claude.ai project use it.

entries.title: Project id
entries.text: Lowercase id from the name: the workspace id, the hub folder /projects/<id>/ and the default repo name.

entries.title: Visibility
entries.text: Whether a repo the wizard creates on GitHub is private or public.

entries.title: Switch into the new project
entries.text: When the project is made, it becomes the active project: builds, notes, to-dos and plans switch to it.

entries.title: Use selected
entries.text: Takes the ticked items in the grid and closes the dialog.

entries.title: Boilerplate
entries.text: Ready-made app parts added on top of the template (optional).

entries.title: Your framework's name
entries.text: The name of the framework this project builds for itself. A framework/ folder is started in the repo.

entries.title: Framework repo
entries.text: A framework to import from GitHub, as owner/name.

entries.title: Framework folder
entries.text: A framework to import from a folder on the console server instead of GitHub.

entries.title: Framework's boilerplate
entries.text: A folder inside the imported framework to copy as the starter code, when the starter is the framework's boilerplate.

entries.title: Pick libraries
entries.text: Opens a grid of the AXF shared libraries to tick the ones the project uses.

entries.title: Skin
entries.text: The look the new project starts with. Leave it on the default to use the console's own look.

entries.title: Browse skins
entries.text: Opens every skin and design package as a grid with their descriptions.

entries.title: Claude account
entries.text: The Claude account that runs this project's builds. Accounts come from the Claude accounts plugin.

entries.title: Browse accounts
entries.text: Opens the Claude accounts as a grid with their plans and which one is active.

entries.title: First plan
entries.text: What the project should do first. Saved as docs/FIRST_PLAN.md; the first Claude session starts from it. Type it or press Speak it.

entries.title: First builds
entries.text: The first builds, one per line. They go into the first plan as a checklist.

entries.title: Choose something else
entries.text: Unticked, this step keeps the current project's value (grayed out). Tick it to pick something new.

entries.title: Speak it
entries.text: Listens and adds what you say to the first plan. Where the browser can't, use AmberX or type it.

entries.title: Create the project
entries.text: Makes the repo, starter code, project files and Claude.ai kit, then the project's workspace, and switches into it.

entries.title: Start from
entries.text: Blank: a new project whose settings start on the current project's. Copy of the current project: its settings, rules, instructions, skin, Claude accounts, plugin setup and lists. A boilerplate: a project saved with Save as boilerplate. The optional steps start on what you pick.

entries.title: Boilerplate
entries.text: Which saved boilerplate the new project starts from. Save one from Projects → Save as boilerplate.
